results.title: Jamuna Bank joins Tk10,000cr BB agricultural refinance scheme
results.description: Jamuna Bank PLC has joined Bangladesh Bank's Tk10,000 crore refinance scheme aimed at increasing agricultural production, strengthening food security and supporting the rural economy. The two institutions signed a participation agreement on 16 August, according to a press release. Under the three-year revolving refinance scheme, financing will be available for a wide range of agricultural and rural activities, including crop production, fisheries, livestock, agricultural and irrigation machinery, and other income-generating activities.
